text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Two hijackers of Air Malta flight to Istanbul to be charged in Germany today. Two Turkish hijackers had demanded a TV interview to appeal for the release of Ali Agca, the Turk who shot Pope John Paul in 1981. The hijackers gave themselves up without incident six hours later. The bombs they said they were carrying were fake.
- Air Malta hijack Boeing aircraft back. Praise for professionalism of crew.
- Government setting up National Commission for Education to advise on long-term planning
- Passengers, crew, back in Malta after Air Malta hijack.
- Maltese man dies in traffic accident in Britain.
